newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest makes A$270 mln from closeout.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest makes A$270 mln from closeout.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Thursday that it achieved an abnormal profit of A$270.0 million from the closeout of gold hedge positions in its first financial quarter.
"On 6 August 1996 the company reported on the close out of two million ounces from its hedge book," Newcrest said in its quarterly report.

"A profit after tax of A$144.4 million was generated and A$300 million of cash was realised. Of this cash amount A$200 million had already been received by way of advances against the hedge position during the 1995/96 financial year," it said.
At end-September, it had 1.137 million ounces hedged at an average deliverable price of A$885 an ounce.
Newcrest said 420,000 ounces mature this financial year and the remaining ounces are evenly spread to 2007/8.
